newsitem.title: CHINA: China central bank revises Q1 M2 as up 21.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: China central bank revises Q1 M2 as up 21.1 pct.

text.p: China's central bank on Monday revised the figure for broad M2 money supply in the first quarter, saying it increased by 21.1 percent, the Xinhua news agency said.
The State Statistical Bureau said last month that China's M2 grew 21.6 percent in the first quarter.

The People's Bank of China, or central bank, also revised the figure for M1, or currency in circulation plus current account deposits, to an increase of 18.4 percent, Xinhua said. The State Statistical Bureau had given the figure as 18.9 percent.
The central bank revised the figure for M0, or currency in circulation, to an increase of 13.6 percent, the agency said. The State Statistical Bureau had given the figure as 13.0 percent.
China's M2 and M1 grew by 25.3 percent and 18.9 percent respectively in 1996. M0 was up 11.6 percent last year.
